notes: A whimsical Matilda-inspired world whose tower is climbed and explored has no objective, nothing to collect and no gate to open, and Adventure's own boundary sends a landmark that is the whole point rather than a reward for reaching it to an Entertainment showcase, so that is where I put it. No catalogue shape fits, so this is a described shape: interior-single says the interior is the entire map, but the author asked for a courtyard world around the tower; route-guided and Entertainment's vignette wording assume one continuous surface, and this is five floors sitting above one another; rooms-sequence assumes rooms on a level worked through in order; and course-tower would import P6 and a jump course from a climb the author describes as walking up through floors. The axes carry it instead — going in and out of the tower is transition (P3), the five floors are stacked (P2) — and everything else is default. I kept the Showcase preset's options over the substituted shape, with the tower as the hero build framed from the courtyard, spawn oriented to face it, and photo spots for the whimsical detail, plus enterable interiors for the floors; about five floors is the stated count.
